_comment: Editor layout for the Parse model over an FCS correlation-curve equation. The equation catalogue lives in core (ParseModel.catalogue), so the picker is a plain `choice` over `catalogue_names` writing `model_name` -- no bespoke section. `rebuild_on_change` matters: a different equation has different parameters, so the table below must be rebuilt, not refreshed.

sections.label: Model
sections.description: Pick an equation from the catalogue; its initial parameter values are applied with it.

sections.label: f(x)
sections.description: The equation, in Python syntax. Every free name becomes a fitted parameter. Committed when you leave the field.
One row per free name in the equation.
